scope: Canonical, source-linked headline evidence for the macOS JBR Skia zero-copy performance and pacing work.

conventions.cpu: CPU percent of one core normalized per benchmark frame where stated.
conventions.gpu_mw_per_kframe: Average GPU power divided by benchmark-frame count, scaled to 1,000 frames.
conventions.gpu_active_per_kframe: GPU active percentage normalized per benchmark frame, scaled to 1,000 frames.
conventions.policy: Values retain the run's pre-registered exclusions. Cross-suite absolute power is not comparable; use within-run deltas or explicitly labeled delta-versus-delta conclusions.

light_telemetry_579_diagnostic.protocol_finding: Heavy collection changes timer-old paint rate materially while the new arm remains near 40.7 paint/s; the earlier N=5 preserves its frozen failed outcome but is protocol-perturbed for pacing causal attribution.

foreign_process_caveat.interpretation: The census is not a GPU-power measurement. Its five-second sample cannot by itself remove the 214 deep events needed to pass, nor the 367 events needed for p95 at most 45ms.

workload_comparison.interpretation: The later guarded agent-blackout launch rejected the requested 456x579 signature because the live quiet surface was 456x909. The layout mechanism remains unidentified, but this diagnostic was measured under the agent-app-open environment rather than the final quiet workload.
